title: WireGuard Peer Status Bytes Received Leaderboard
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wireguard:peer rx_bytes=*
| stats sum(rx_bytes) as total_value, avg(rx_bytes) as avg_value by peer_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks peer values by total and average bytes received across WireGuard peer status events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rx_bytes` values for each WireGuard peer status event and review total and average bytes received by peer.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total bytes received.
grandmaExplanation: It neatly which peer shows the biggest bytes received numbers in your WireGuard peer status data.
